cases.name: production excludes test mount
cases.source: #[cfg(test)] #[path = "test.rs"] mod tests; pub fn production() {}

cases.name: feature selects module
cases.source: #[cfg(feature = "engine")] mod engine; #[cfg(not(feature = "engine"))] mod portable;

cases.name: nested target predicates
cases.source: #[cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", not(target_env = "p2")))] mod browser; #[cfg(any(test, target_env = "p2"))] mod guest;

cases.name: inline module inherits exclusion
cases.source: #[cfg(test)] mod tests { #[path = "fixture.rs"] mod fixture; } mod production { #[cfg(test)] mod nested; pub fn live() {} }

cases.name: cfg attribute selects literal path
cases.source: #[cfg_attr(target_os = "windows", path = "windows.rs")] #[cfg_attr(not(target_os = "windows"), path = "unix.rs")] mod platform;

cases.name: macro_rules bodies keep metavariable cfg attributes for their expansion site
cases.source: macro_rules! scoped { ($scope:meta, $name:ident) => { #[cfg($scope)] pub fn $name() {} }; } #[cfg(test)] mod tests; #[cfg(unix)] scoped!(unix, native);
cases.expected: macro_rules! scoped { ($scope:meta, $name:ident) => { #[cfg($scope)] pub fn $name() {} }; } scoped!(unix, native);

cases.name: inner file cfg excludes whole owning Source
cases.source: #![cfg(test)] mod missing; pub struct Inactive;

cases.name: inner inline cfg excludes its owned contents
cases.source: mod gate { #![cfg(test)] mod missing; pub struct Inactive; } pub struct Active;

cases.name: inner cfg_attr selects active file metadata
cases.source: #![cfg_attr(unix, allow(dead_code))] mod child;

cases.name: cfg-false last struct literal field before the closing brace
cases.source: struct S{a:u8,b:u8} fn f()->S{ S{a:1, #[cfg(test)] b:2 } }

cases.name: cfg-false last struct literal field before a statement terminator
cases.source: struct S{a:u8,b:u8} fn f()->S{ let s = S{a:1, #[cfg(test)] b:2 }; s }
cases.expected: struct S{a:u8,b:u8} fn f()->S{ let s = S{a:1, }; s }

cases.name: cfg-false last struct literal field without comma keeps the enclosing statement
cases.source: struct S{a:u8,b:u8} fn f()->S{ let s = S{a:1, #[cfg(test)] b:2}; s } fn g(){}
cases.expected: struct S{a:u8,b:u8} fn f()->S{ let s = S{a:1, }; s } fn g(){}

cases.name: cfg-false tail expression ends at the enclosing brace
cases.source: fn sync(f:&Fl)->u8{ f.flush(); #[cfg(not(feature = "durable"))] f.sync_all().map_err(io) } struct Fl; fn after(){}
cases.expected: fn sync(f:&Fl)->u8{ f.flush(); } struct Fl; fn after(){}

cases.name: cfg-false tail expression in nested blocks stays inside its own block
cases.source: fn f(){ { { #[cfg(test)] g() } } h(); } fn g(){} fn h(){}

cases.name: cfg-false tail statement block ends at the enclosing brace
cases.source: fn f(){ h(); #[cfg(test)] { g() } } fn g(){} fn h(){}
cases.expected: fn f(){ h(); } fn g(){} fn h(){}

cases.name: cfg-false last call argument and last array element
cases.source: fn g(a:u8,b:u8){} fn f(){ g(1, #[cfg(test)] 2); let _a = [1, #[cfg(test)] 2]; }

cases.name: cfg-false last match arm without comma
cases.source: fn f(x:u8)->u8{ match x { 0 => 1, #[cfg(test)] _ => 2 } }

cases.name: cfg-false match arm with a struct pattern is removed whole
cases.source: struct P{a:u8} fn f(p:P)->u8{ match p { #[cfg(test)] P{a} => a, P{..} => 2 } }
cases.expected: struct P{a:u8} fn f(p:P)->u8{ match p { P{..} => 2 } }

cases.name: cfg-false last enum variant and last struct field with generic commas
cases.source: enum E{A, #[cfg(test)] B(u8,u8)} struct T{a:u8, #[cfg(test)] pub b: std::collections::HashMap<u8,u8>} struct U{ #[cfg(test)] m: std::collections::HashMap<u8,u8>, n:u8 }
cases.expected: enum E{A, } struct T{a:u8, } struct U{ n:u8 }

cases.name: cfg-false item with generic commas is removed whole
cases.source: #[cfg(test)] fn f<A, B>(){} #[cfg(test)] struct K<A, B>(A, B); #[cfg(test)] type M = std::collections::HashMap<u8, u8>; fn live(){}

cases.name: cfg-false let statement with generic commas is removed whole
cases.source: fn f(){ #[cfg(test)] let m: std::collections::HashMap<u8, u8> = Default::default(); let k = 1; }

cases.name: cfg-false let statement keeps its else branch
cases.source: fn f(){ #[cfg(test)] let v = if true { 1 } else { 2 }; let k = 1; }

cases.name: cfg-false expression statement keeps method chains after a block
cases.source: fn f(){ #[cfg(test)] match 1 { _ => 2 }.max(3); let k = 1; }

cases.name: cfg-false removal ignores delimiters inside strings, chars, raw strings and comments
cfg-false item with raw string and braces in its body
cases.source: #[cfg(test)] const X: &str = r##"} "# {"##; #[cfg(test)] fn t(){ let _ = "}"; let _c = '{'; } fn live(){}

cases.name: lifetimes in cfg-false items do not open character literals
cases.source: #[cfg(test)] fn f<'a, 'b>(x: &'a str, y: &'b str) -> &'a str { let _ = 'x'; x } fn live<'a>(x:&'a str)->&'a str{ x }

cases.name: attributes with nested parentheses select against the full predicate
cases.source: #[cfg(all(test, any(feature = "a", not(feature = "b"))))] fn on(){} #[cfg(all(test, any(feature = "b", not(feature = "a"))))] fn off(){} #[cfg_attr(all(test, feature = "a"), derive(Debug, Clone))] struct S;

cases.name: cfg-true last struct literal field only drops the attribute
cases.source: struct S{a:u8,b:u8} fn f()->S{ S{a:1, #[cfg(test)] b:2 } }
cases.expected: struct S{a:u8,b:u8} fn f()->S{ S{a:1, b:2 } }

cases.name: cfg-false inline module as last item of an enclosing module
cases.source: mod m { pub fn live(){} #[cfg(test)] mod tests { fn t(){ let _ = "}"; } } } fn after(){}
cases.expected: mod m { pub fn live(){} } fn after(){}

cases.name: cfg-false match arm with alternated struct patterns is removed whole
cases.source: struct P{a:u8} struct Q{a:u8} fn f(p:P)->u8{ match p { #[cfg(test)] P{a} | P{a:_} => 1, _ => 2 } }
cases.expected: struct P{a:u8} struct Q{a:u8} fn f(p:P)->u8{ match p { _ => 2 } }
